answer: Weight starts at zero until a key can present a relic: one of its own prior-epoch countersignatures on a peer's answer, chosen by a VRF over the epoch seed and its attestation list. Keys with fewer than four such items cannot enter. The committee then issues a whisper, a 90-second nonce, to three established peers from disjoint invite trees; the applicant must countersign so all three receipts match. If two relics fall in the same 3-second quartz timestamp bucket and their funding parents overlap, both deposits slash. Fake keys lack history and cannot pre-share a time-bounded nonce.
